'''Wenshui''' is an NPC in [[Huanglong]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Wenshu:''' Welcome to Wenshu Repair, we fix your broken things and broken backs. How may I be of help, sir?
:{{DIcon}} About the routine maintenance.
::'''Wenshu:''' The old neighbors around here consider me a "fix-it" guy when it comes to daily items. Although, I'm not sophisticated enough to repair high-end items.
::'''Wenshu:''' As long as it's a day-to-day thing found around the house, I can always fix them when you come to me.
::'''Wenshu:''' The elders are used to living in frugality and don't have a habit of throwing away things that are old or broken. That's why some out-dated electrical parts can only be found here.
::'''Wenshu:''' Hey, I gradually grew attached while repairing these old gadgets. After all, we're all a bit nostalgic.
:{{DIcon}} Who's that kid...?
::'''Wenshu:''' Oh, you're speaking of [[Wenmo]]. He's my son. That boy always likes to be alone, tinkering with mechanical things.
::'''Wenshu:''' He has been watching me repair these things since he was a child, and perhaps he has memorized the steps just by watching.
::'''Wenshu:''' Sometimes, I have to read an instruction manual for some of the more complex items customers bring in, but he'd be able to understand and start dismantling the structure in a few minutes.
::'''Wenshu:''' Once I caught him completely disassembling an item to its last gear. I panicked so hard as I thought there had been no way to restore it. But he put it back together in moments like it was brand new.
::'''Wenshu:''' He also fixed those things. So, I let him do his things from then on. Later, he became increasingly more sophisticated with it.
::'''Wenshu:''' Maybe one day he can become a great inventor. And I'll be known as the father of a great inventor.
:{{DIcon}} About the repair shop.
::'''Wenshu:''' This repair shop has also been on this street for many years. Maybe it's eligible to be a AAAA tourist destination in [[Jinzhou]] in another few decades.
::'''Wenshu:''' Well, I'm not ashamed to crack this to you: I opened this shop because I had no talents. My late grandfather was once a prominent craftsman in the Ministry of Development.
::'''Wenshu:''' I didn't match his talents and had to live under his halo as the grandson of the celebrity craftsman.
::'''Wenshu:''' Like "If it's him, he can definitely do it...", but I can't be as perfect as my father.
::'''Wenshu:''' Later, I left the [[Ministry of Development]] and opened this shop. Now I'm content with this life of fixing things for the folks of Jinzhou.
::'''Wenshu:''' But the talent of Wenmo was as high as his grandfather's, and he may be able to accomplish what I have not done in the future.
::'''Wenshu:''' I really hope to see that day.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
